OtherNames: Atlantic-See LNG FSRU; second Alexandroupolis FSRU (AKTOR/DEPA)
Location: Alexandroupolis area (Aegean Sea); location not yet finalized, sponsor focusing on Alexandroupolis with a second site under consideration
ResearcherNotesProject: New AKTOR/DEPA JV 'Atlantic SEE LNG Trade SA', formed Nov 2025 at the 6th PTEC conference in Athens. Signed a 20-year SPA with Venture Global (7 Nov 2025) for min 0.5 MTPA (potential expansion) of US LNG from 2030 - Greece's first long-term LNG SPA with a US exporter; VG's offtake is ~25% of the planned terminal's capacity. Plans a dedicated 4.5-5 bcm/y FSRU; per ProtoThema (Apr 2026), location not yet finalized but focusing on Alexandroupolis with a second site under consideration; targeted operation late 2028/early 2029, no later than 2030. Distinct sponsor/SPA from the existing Gastrade Alexandroupolis and proposed Gastrade Thrace FSRUs - staged as a separate terminal, not a Gastrade unit. RE-SOURCING NOTE (this pass): the JV's existence and both parent companies (AKTOR + DEPA) are corroborated by two independent non-GEM sources (Venture Global IR, To Vima), but NEITHER independent source states the 60%/40% ownership split - the percentages from the prior draft could NOT be corroborated off-GEM and were DROPPED from the Parent field (parents kept without percentages); the split should be confirmed against a JV-formation filing before being entered. Capacity 4.5-5 bcm/y is confirmed by a single source (ProtoThema) -> Capacity stays yellow. The Venture Global press release does NOT contain the exact string 'Atlantic SEE' (it writes 'Atlantic-See LNG' and frames the JV via AKTOR/DEPA); its [ref] usages are limited to the facts it actually states (the AKTOR/DEPA JV, US-LNG SPA, import facility, association with Alexandroupolis). Location/AssociatedTerminals provisional pending site finalization.
Source: Venture Global IR (sponsor); ProtoThema; To Vima
